Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (a) The bidder has to upload the certificate of acceptance of all the terms and conditions of the bid alongwi th the bid reference number. (b) Eqpt will be delivered as per the specifications mentioned by the user. (c) Bids submitted by different firms from the same IP address will be rejected. (d) Missing details, if any, will assumed as per good Engineering practice and will be provided by the vend or after being approved by Commanding Officer 115 Engineer Regiment. (e) Samples will be produced by the L1 vendor for approval and bulk delivery will be made only after samp le approval within the stipulated delivery period. No additional time will be granted for sample approval. (f) Quoted cost should include cost of transportation and testing of Installation of equipment at site. (g) In case of any ambiguity in any given technical specification Vendor must clarify the same from CO 115 Engineer Regiment or detailed Engineer rep before participation in bid through representation on GeM. (h). Delivery & Installation (Turnkey Supply & Installation) * All items must be supplied, unloaded, placed, and fully installed at the designated site by the Seller. * Inclusive Pricing: The quoted bid price shall be deemed all-inclusive of hardware, brackets, wiring, tools, l abour, transportation, transit insurance, and any miscellaneous accessories required for complete installati on and operational readiness. No extra payment will be made for installation materials. (j). Site Visit. Site visit can be organised for the interested bidders as per gem terms and conditions. (k). Inspection & Payment Terms. 100% payment will be released only after successful supply, testing, and formal Satisfactory Acceptance / Completion Certificate issued by the Buyer’s designated officer. Any item found damaged, defective, or not complying with the technical specifications during inspection must be re placed by the Seller at no additional cost within 7 days. (l). Site Protection & Cleanliness. The Seller shall take all precautions to avoid damaging the Buyer's premi ses during installation. The Seller must clean the site and remove all packaging, off-cuts, and debris upon completion of the work. .
